method: Explicit sixteen-song vocal whitelist; complete source audio; budgeted stereo MP3; spectral onset envelope and dynamic-programming beat tracking (librosa); estimated downbeat phase; deterministic phrase masks, then bounded strong-attack refinement on causal PCM energy after synthetic calibration. Four spatial chapter labels match LevelArt; boundaries estimate nearby PCM/timbre changes and selected rhythm cues, not verified verse/chorus bars. No source audio metadata retained.
chartStatus: Song-specific repeated/call-response phrase templates with calibrated, confidence-gated attack refinement. Machine-assisted estimates, not human listening acceptance. Four spatial stages estimate real PCM/timbre changes; not manually annotated bars.

attackCalibration.fixture: 31 known PCM burst starts; bass/mid/high tone + seeded noise; 1/4/8ms attack ramps, three levels, sustained background. No global compensation fitted.
